svg.title: Find the policy point for a VLAN flow
svg.desc: Peers in the same VLAN can exchange switched traffic without crossing a routing firewall. Traffic between different IP networks takes a routing path, where firewall rules apply if the flow crosses the enforceable interface.

g.text: Find the policy point for a VLAN flow
Ordinary switching can keep the flow local.
Use an appropriate Layer 2 or endpoint control.
Identify the device that routes the flow.
Apply and verify policy where it actually crosses.
Test allowed and denied paths from their intended source zones. Check for alternate routes.
